# dsh-engineering-skills

Matt Pocock's skills — 27 engineering and
productivity agent skills (grilling, spec/ticket flows, TD

D, code review, domain
modelling, handoff, …) — packaged as a **DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle**: on
ugin removes them cleanly.
> The harness is in developer preview and iterates quickly — expect compatibility-breaking changes.
> 中文说明见 README.zh.md.

## Why a plugin at all

You do **not** need this plugin to use the skills: DSH's filesystem provider scans
`~/.agents/skills

` (rank 500) and `<project>/.agents/skills` (rank 200) by default,
and upstream's installer drops th

e same `SKILL.md` trees there — the format,
frontmatter and `disable-model-invocation` semantics are

rees there — the format,
frontmatter and `disable-model-invocation` semantics are already identical.

The plugin adds: one-command install/uninstall managed by the profile, versioned
updates pinned to a

n upstream commit (`UPSTREAM.json`, `sync --check`), no writes
to the shared `~/.agents/skills`, cat

egory/name filtering to keep the catalog
prompt small, and a short DSH tool-mapping note appended on

name filtering to keep the catalog
prompt small, and a short DSH tool-mapping note appended on load.
## Install
### Prerequisites

The `dsh` CLI must be on your `PATH` (`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`, or prefix
commands with `np
x @deepseek-ai/dsh`). This release is verified on harness `0.2.1-rc.2`.
### Add the bundle

After the restart the `/` menu lists all 27 skills (16 user-only + 11 dual-channel)
and the model ca

talog carries the 11 model-invoked ones; `dsh-engineering-skills` appears under
Settings → Plugins.

## Config
[代码示例省略，未执行]

A non-empty `skills` list overrides `categories` entirely; unknown categories or
skill names fail th
e mount instead of silently shrinking the catalog.
## Mapping (upstream → DSH)
| Upstream | DSH |

| `SKILL.md` bundle + YAML frontmatter | same format, parsed by the skill registry |
| `disable-mode
l-invocation: true` (16 skills) | `{ modelInvocable: false, userInvocable: true }` — `/` menu only,

never in the catalog or `skill` tool |
| default (11 model-invoked) | `{ modelInvocable: true, userI

nvocable: true }` — catalog + `skill` tool + `/name` |
| `/name` slash command | `/name` gesture, ho

st injects the same `<skill_content>` block; no commands needed |
| `agents/openai.yaml` | dropped (

Codex UI metadata, unread by DSH) |
| referenced sub-files (25) | `resourceBase: { kind: 'directory'

}`; the `skill` result carries the base directory |
| `Skill tool` wording | rewritten by the sync
script to `` `skill` tool `` |
## Syncing upstream
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Both modes also verify that `UPSTREAM.json` `version` matches the version declared by
the fetched up

stream commit (`package.json` / `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`), so a stale
version string cannot pass
`--check` by being copied into the manifest.

Release flow: bump `UPSTREAM.json` → sync → `pnpm test` → tag. Only skills listed
in upstream's `.cl
aude-plugin/plugin.json` ship; `in-progress/` and `misc/` never do.
## Known limits

- **`ask-matt` needs a rewrite**: it promises to read other *user-invoked* skills'
bodies, which DSH

deliberately never exposes to the model. Recast it as
human-facing navigation ("run `/x` yourself")

.
- **`implement-spec` worktrees**: no first-party worktree tool; the skill must
drive `git worktree

` itself or run serially.
- **`triage` / `wayfinder` / `to-*` need an issue tracker**: prefer the se

tup
skill's Local-markdown mode (`.scratch/`) where `gh`/`glab` are unavailable.
- **`improve-codeba

mp/output**: OS temp and `open` become workspace paths + `present`.
- **Catalog cost**: 11 model-inv

oked descriptions are resident each request; trim
with `categories`.
- **English bodies**: add a lan

guage line to the project's `AGENTS.md` for Chinese
output.
- **Harness upgrades**: bump the `@deeps

eek-ai/dsh-skill` peer range with each
runtime prerelease and re-run `pnpm test`.
## Harness compatibility

Only `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` is gated as a peer (checked at install and at
profile startup; an out-

of-range bundle is skipped with `skipping profile bundle …`,
i.e. the plugin silently disappears aft

er a harness upgrade). Prerelease semver
needs an explicit match: `^0.2.1-rc.2` covers `0.2.1-rc.2`

and later `0.2.x`
releases but not a new prerelease such as `0.2.2-rc.1`, so bump the peer range on

each harness prerelease and re-run `pnpm test`. No build step is involved: `lib/`
is runnable ESM an
d `skills/` is data.
## Development

Managed with pnpm `11.28.5` (`packageManager` field; CI pins the same version). Other
major pnpm ver

sions may rewrite `pnpm-lock.yaml`; check the lockfile diff before committing.
The contract baseline

is REQUIREMENTS.md — change it first when a
service, field or config semantic moves.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`test-package.mjs` checks the `cordis.patch.yml` insert row, the npm `files` whitelist,
manifest-vs-

tree consistency and the peer/license files; CI additionally unpacks the
packed tarball and imports
it, so the published artifact is exercised, not just the repo.
